sloka: स्फीतान् जन पदान् रम्यान् विपुलानि पुराणि च ।पुंनाग गहनम् कुक्षिम् वकुल उद्दालक आकुलम् ॥४-४२-७॥
transliteration: sphītān jana padān ramyān vipulāni purāṇi ca ।puṁnāga gahanam kukṣim vakula uddālaka ākulam ॥4-42-7॥

translations.english: 'O leaders of monkeys search for Sita in the countries of Saurashtra, and also Bahlika, Chandrachitra, in delightful villages and vast towns, also in Kukshi covered haphazardly with punnaga, bakula and uddalaka trees as well as ketaka shrubs.
